content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RARS Chintapalle Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for RARS Chintapalle Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for RARS Chintapalle Recruitment is scheduled for 7 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in RARS Chintapalle Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Teaching Associate and Teaching Assistants. There is 1 vacancy for Teaching Associate and 3 vacancies for Teaching Assistants.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: For Teaching Associate, candidates need a Ph.D in Agricultural sciences or a Master's Degree in Agricultural sciences with specific experience and publications as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for Teaching Assistant is a B.Sc (Ag) or B.Tech (Ag.Engg) degree of four years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Teaching Associate and Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: The age limit for Teaching Associate is a maximum of 45 years (40 for men, 45 for women), and for Teaching Assistant, it is a maximum of 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Teaching Associates can expect a salary between Rs. 61,000/- to Rs. 67,000/- per month plus HRA. Teaching Assistants will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the RARS Chintapalle Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Interested candidates need to attend the walk-in interview at the specified venue and time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Regional Agricultural Research Station, Chintapalle, Alluri Sitharamaraju District, AP-531111.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
